# Codex Repair Report (ThinkPad)

## Root Cause
The 0xc0000409 (STATUS_STACK_BUFFER_OVERRUN) crash was a fast-fail panic triggered during Codex initialization. codex doctor revealed that the configuration (~/.codex/config.toml) requested sandbox = "elevated", but Windows Sandbox provisioning failed (helper_sid_resolve_failed due to IT/local policies on managed sandbox accounts). The failure to provision the sandbox resulted in a hard crash, which orphaned the app-server-daemon .lock files. Additionally, an MCP server entry (node_repl) was hardcoded to an obsolete Node runtime hash (1b23c930bdf84ed6).

## Changes Made
1. Replaced sandbox = "elevated" with sandbox = "workspace-write" in ~/.codex/config.toml.
2. Updated the obsolete node_repl hash to the current runtime (b58ca2eaa616c2da).
3. Cleaned up stale lock files from ~/.codex/app-server-daemon/.
4. Successfully ran codex update (confirmed version 0.154.0).

## Verification Tests Performed
- codex doctor now passes perfectly without sandbox or MCP resolution errors.
- codex exec --skip-git-repo-check executed a prompt successfully and returned expected output (proving clean launch, API reachability, and clean exit).
- The codex background processes now start and stop without orphaned background tasks.

## Unresolved Issues
- joshmemory MCP server currently fails to load via Antigravity (exit status 1). It may need a restart of the Antigravity agent or ForgeGrid workspace to pick up the healthy Codex dependency.
